explanation: Engineer Masahiro Hara designed it in 1994 at a Toyota group parts maker to track car parts. The board game Go helped inspire its grid.

claims.text: QR does not stand for Quick Read, Quality Record or Query Reference.
Masahiro Hara developed the QR code in 1994 at Nippondenso (later renamed Denso), a Toyota group car-parts maker, to track automotive parts.
Hara has said that the board game Go helped inspire the design of the QR code.
